title: Welcome to CannonCommander
lead: Lovely to have you here! How would you like to work?
singleHow: One folder across the full width, with the sidebar beside it. A good fit for smaller screens.
dualHow: Two folders side by side. F5 copies and F6 moves to the other panel.
hintDesktop: You can change it any time in the settings under Keyboard shortcuts.
hintWeb: Switch any time in the View menu or with Ctrl+1 and Ctrl+2.
